# Ghosterm managed config
# 顶层注释：不得被动过

Host web
  # 生产入口
  HostName 10.0.0.5
  User ops
  Port 2222
  IdentityFile keystore://host-a/id_ed25519
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/plain_key
  VisualHostKey yes
  Ciphers aes256-gcm@openssh.com
  ServerAliveInterval 30

Host db
  HostName 10.0.0.6
  User dba
  ProxyJump web
  SetEnv DBMODE=ro DBTRACE=1
  LocalForward 5432 localhost:5432
  LocalForward 6432 localhost:6432
  RemoteForward 9000 localhost:9000
  Compression yes
  ForwardAgent no
  RequestTTY force
  StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new

Host bastion
  HostName bastion.example.com
  User jumpuser
  Port 2200
  IdentityFile=~/.ssh/bastion_key
